body: {"better": "B", "reason": "Card A uses 'నడిచి వెళ్ళండి' which is grammatically awkward/incomplete (needs a subject, sounds like an instruction to someone else rather than 'we walk'); Card B's 'నడవండి' is cleaner though still slightly imperative. More importantly, Card A says 'Markt చూడవచ్చు' which uses English 'Markt' unnecessarily when Telugu 'మార్కెట్' exists, while Card B uses natural Telugu 'మార్కెట్'. Card B also gives a reason to enjoy ('సందడిగా ఉంటుంది' -
